# Newport Sailing School and Tours

> Newport Sailing School and Tours has been operating in Newport, Rhode Island, since 1971. Located at Goat Island Marina, the business offers sailing instruction and tours.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 5 Marina Plaza, Goat Island Marina, Dock A5, Newport, RI 02840
- Phone: +14018482266
- Email: info@newportsailing.com
